title: Socially Aware Bias Measurements for Hindi Language Representations
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is to devise and apply measures to detect and quantify societal biases in Hindi language representations. A significant part of this work is dedicated to investigating and measuring religion-associated biases, particularly focusing on stereotypes related to Hinduism and Islam within the Indian cultural context. This involves creating specific word lists and tests (WEAT, SEAT) using religious terms, entities, and last names, making the evaluation of religion-related bias a core component of the research, not a peripheral discussion.
